# Assay README Template

## Assay Title

Whole-cell metabolism assay

## Assay Description

To characterize D3 activity in the cell lines, we first measured endogenous D3 activity in the intact cells

Deiodinase activity (D3) in intact cells was determined for MO3.13 and SK-N-AS cells in the whole-cell metabolism assay. Cells were exposed for 24 hours to CT-medium, 1 nM T3, 2.000.000 cpm/ml [125I]T3 and EDCs.
Samples were analysed on UPLC coupled to a RAMONA star. The percentage conversion was based on %T1 and %T2 formed, in which %T1 was counted double because of two deiodination steps.
Data are expressed as percentage conversion relative to the average conversion in solvent controls. 

Reference compounds tested: iopanoic acid, xanthohumol 
EDCs tested: silychristin, sulfobromophthalein, chlorpyrifos, Tetrabromobisphenol A

## File Organization
[Briefly explain how do the files in the folder relate to eachother]

The paper has two parts: characterisation of deiodinase (D3) activity of two intact cell lines (MO3.13, SK-N-AS) and testing reference compounds of EDCs. 
assay3_characterisation: processed and raw data files of characterisation of three cell lines
assay3:_EDCs: processed and raw data files of endocrine disrupting chemicals tested in the assay
